notes: Six deterministic local multi-step jobs. {{ORIGIN}} and {{WORKSPACE}} are per-run values. {{FAKE_PASSWORD}} is expanded only for condition A; condition B reads the redacted handle from the credential card. expectedPayload is an exact recursive match against the single recorded final POST. Live variants are in bench/live/tasks.json and are not part of Phase 1.

tasks.instruction: I need a one-way flight from Marseille to London on 14 November 2026. Use the airport autocomplete and calendar, then filter to Nonstop and sort by price. Which is the cheapest nonstop flight? Give its airline, departure time and price, plus the departure time of the second-cheapest nonstop flight.

Get me a test insurance quote for Maya Chen, born 1990-04-17. She has prior claims: 2. Start with annual kilometres 14000, choose Comprehensive cover, $500 excess, and include roadside assistance. If the server rejects the annual kilometres, read its error and correct that field to 12000 before reviewing and submitting. What is the quote reference?

Apply to the Product engineer job for Jordan Lee, email jordan.lee@example.test, phone +1 202 555 0147. Upload {{WORKSPACE}}/resume.pdf. Add a second past job: job 1 is Northwind, Support analyst, 2020-2022; job 2 is Acme, Operations lead, 2022-2025. Submit the application and tell me the confirmation id.
Buy the Everyday Jacket in size M, colour blue, quantity 2. Apply coupon BLUE10, go to checkout and pay. Tell me the order id when it is confirmed.
This is my disposable local test site. Sign in as demo.user@example.test with the fake password {{FAKE_PASSWORD}}, then read the account's current plan. What plan is it?
tasks.instructionB: This is my disposable local test site. Open the saved fake credential card and use its redacted credential to sign in as demo.user@example.test, then read the account's current plan. Never ask me for the password value. What plan is it?

tasks.instruction: In the customer revenue table, filter Region to North and sort Revenue high to low. Page through the matching rows and report the top 3 companies with their revenue, in order. The filter and sort must stay applied as you page.
